$schema_note: User-facing morph parameter definitions for the Avatar Engine. Params are 0..1 with 0.5 = neutral. Engine formula per target: shape_key_value = (param - 0.5) * 2 * weight. One user param may drive several underlying shape keys. This file is the single source of truth for Blender tooling, backend AI output, and the Three.js runtime.

face_width.label: Face Width
face_width.description: Overall width of the head and face.

forehead_height.label: Forehead Height
forehead_height.description: Height of the forehead / hairline area.

cheek_size.label: Cheek Fullness
cheek_size.description: Fullness of the cheeks (gaunt to chubby).

cheekbone_height.label: Cheekbone Height
cheekbone_height.description: Vertical position and prominence of the cheekbones.

jaw_height.label: Jaw Length
jaw_height.description: Vertical length of the lower face.

jaw_angle.label: Jaw Definition
jaw_angle.description: Squareness of the jaw corners (soft to chiseled).

chin_size.label: Chin Size
chin_size.description: Projection and size of the chin.

nose_width.label: Nose Width
nose_width.description: Width of the nose and nostrils.

nose_length.label: Nose Length
nose_length.description: Length of the nose from bridge to tip.

nose_bridge_height.label: Nose Bridge
nose_bridge_height.description: Projection of the nose bridge (flat to prominent).

nose_tip_size.label: Nose Tip
nose_tip_size.description: Size of the nose tip (pointed to bulbous).

eye_tilt.label: Eye Tilt
eye_tilt.description: Canthal tilt (downturned to upturned outer corners).

philtrum_length.label: Philtrum Length
philtrum_length.description: Distance between nose and upper lip.

ear_size.label: Ear Size
ear_size.description: Size and protrusion of the ears.
